name: Azure DevOps Work Item To PR
description: Turn an authorized Azure Boards work item into scoped implementation, validation, a linked PR, and a traceable handoff.
approval_boundaries: Require authority for work-item mutation and PR creation.
Require separate completion authorization and passing policies.

phases.name: Work item context
phases.instructions: Read the work item, linkage, state, constraints, and requested outcome.

phases.name: Repository context
phases.instructions: Map relevant source, commands, rules, and risks.

phases.name: Implementation plan
phases.instructions: Create small testable slices linked to acceptance criteria.

phases.name: Source check
phases.instructions: Confirm the implementation against authoritative source behavior.

phases.name: Implementation
phases.instructions: Implement the work item in small verified slices.

phases.name: PR preparation
phases.instructions: Run local validation and prepare the review package.

phases.name: Authorized PR creation
phases.instructions: Create or update the linked PR only with explicit authority.

phases.name: Required policies
phases.instructions: Inspect required policies and build validation.

phases.name: Independent PR review
phases.instructions: Review PR metadata, work-item traceability, findings, and policies.

phases.name: Work-item-to-PR handoff
phases.instructions: Report work item, PR, validation, policies, risks, and next authorized action.
